parrafo.es: Instant Handyman es un equipo móvil que atiende Pompano Beach y sus alrededores. Hacen desde renovaciones de baño y cocina hasta instalación de ventiladores, luces y ensamblaje de muebles. Amine y su equipo llegan puntuales, cobran precios justos y explican cada paso del trabajo.
parrafo.en: Instant Handyman is a mobile crew serving Pompano Beach and the surrounding area. They handle everything from bathroom and kitchen remodeling to fan and light installs, furniture assembly and general repairs. Amine and the team show up on time, charge fair prices and walk you through every step.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten lo mismo en sus reseñas de Google: profesional, puntual y con precios justos. Amine en particular aparece mencionado una y otra vez por la calidad del trabajo y por dejar todo limpio al terminar.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing in their Google reviews: professional, prompt, and fairly priced. Amine in particular is named again and again for the quality of the work and for leaving everything clean when the job is done.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas: un baño, una cocina, instalaciones o una reparación general.

texto.es: El equipo revisa el trabajo y te da un precio justo y claro antes de empezar.

texto.es: Te explican cada paso mientras resuelven el trabajo con cuidado y sin dejar desorden.
texto.en: They walk you through each step while they get the work done with care and no mess left behind.

texto.es: Trabajo terminado bien y a tiempo, tal como lo describen sus clientes.
texto.en: Work done well and on time, exactly as their clients describe it.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el alcance. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the scope of work. Call and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Renovaciones de baño y cocina, desde duchas con tile decorativo hasta vanitorios con encimera de mármol como los que ves en nuestras fotos.
texto.en: Bathroom and kitchen renovations, from showers with decorative tile to marble-top vanities like the ones you can see in our photos.

texto.es: Instalación de ventiladores de techo, luces y tiras LED, incluida la programación de los controles cuando aplica.
texto.en: Ceiling fan installs, light fixtures and LED strip lighting, including setting up the controls when it applies.

texto.es: Armado de muebles de interior y exterior, patios y terrazas cerradas, listos para usar el mismo día.
texto.en: Assembly of indoor and outdoor furniture, patios and screened lanais, ready to use the same day.

texto.es: Cualquier otro problema de la casa. Los clientes cuentan que el equipo resuelve lo que surja, con precios justos desde el inicio.
texto.en: Any other issue around the house. Clients say the team handles whatever comes up, with fair prices from the start.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto en la lista? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your project listed? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: Amine was professional, courteous and prompt. We had him install 3 lights and 2 ceiling fans. He went above and beyond by making sure fans were programmed and even helped fix a light that was damaged upon delivery. He was great and highly recommend him!

Thank you Amine! He did an amazing job installing the "bit complicated" fan in the laundry room, and helping to program the fixture in the app! He also replaced the lighting for the bathrooms. He was prompt, polite & fairly priced. Will definitely be calling for his services again!

Amine did a great job in my new house. I needed someone to open the drywall on the shower wall to install a niche and it's perfect. No mess! Also he did help us with other installations. He is very dedicated and responsible!
Amine has been to my home several times for handyman repairs and installation of various items. He is professional, very reliable, and on time. He provides a good value for the work that he performs.
